headline: Trump 🍊👑 SQUEEZES 🇨🇦 Canada 🦫🧀 Trade Deal 🍁⏰ DOWN TO THE WIRE 💥🕛
text: Canada-US Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc 🧔‍♂️🤝 just told reporters in Washington 🏛️💼 that 'we have MORE WORK TO DO 💪😩' as the midnight 🔥🕛 Friday deadline for a US-Canada trade deal LOOMS like a bad hangover 🍺😵. LeBlanc spent EIGHT HOURS 🕗⏳ hammering out details with US Trade Rep Jamieson Greer 🦅🤝 and other suits, making it one of the LONGEST sessions yet as talks go down to the wire like a hockey shootout 🏒🥅. President Donald Trump 🍊👑 told reporters the deal is 'MOVING ALONG 🚶‍♂️💨' and 'we should be able to have a deal with Canada' while starting on a new one with Mexico 🇲🇽🍹, bragging 'I only make GOOD DEALS 💰✅.' Leaked details suggest the US will cut tariffs on Canadian steel 🏗️🔩 and aluminum from 50% to 25% and autos 🚗🔧 from 25% to 15%, while Canada 🦫🍁 considers letting American dairy farmers 🐄🧀 into its 'POWERFUL' market and restoring US alcohol sales 🍺🍷 on liquor shelves. Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre 🦅💼 called any 'one-sided' tariff deal 'A BAD DEAL 🛑😠' warning about 'de-industrialisation' of Canadian industry 🏭❌. Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew 🦬💪 publicly called Trump a 'bad person 😡👎' and said Canada 'SHOULD FIGHT 🥊💥' instead of rushing concessions, while Quebec Premier Christine Fréchette 🧀🇨🇦 is analyzing the dairy impact before restoring US booze sales 🍺🔄. Ontario Mayor Matthew Shoemaker 🏙️⚙️ warned that 25% tariffs on Canada's second-largest steel producer 'wouldn't be something to CELEBRATE 🎉🙅‍♂️.' Economists estimate Canada could LOSE 90,000 JOBS 💼📉 if Trump's threatened 50% tariffs on hockey sticks 🏒🍁, wine 🍷, and cement 🏗️ hit. PM Mark Carney 🧔‍♂️🦁 campaigned on an 'elbows-up' tough guy approach but polls show 56% of Canadians want a HARDLINE stance 🛡️💪. In leaked audio, VP JD Vance 🧔‍♂️🎙️ joked that Carney tried to 'out-tough Donald Trump' but ultimately 'climbed down on a lot of issues' like a game of chicken gone wrong 🐔💨.
